name: azel-motion-studio
description: Azel Studio product film production kit

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.tsx AzelFilmVertical renders/Azel-24s-1080x1920.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.render:short: remotion render src/index.tsx AzelShortVertical renders/Azel-15s-1080x1920.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.render:feed: remotion render src/index.tsx AzelFilmFeed renders/Azel-24s-1080x1350.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.render:wide: remotion render src/index.tsx AzelFilmWide renders/Azel-24s-1920x1080.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.preview: remotion render src/index.tsx AzelFilmVertical renders/Azel-preview.mp4 --scale 0.5 --codec h264 --crf 22 --pixel-format yuv420p
